entities.summary: Maria Pierina De Micheli was a Roman Catholic religious sister who was born near Milan in Italy. She is best known for her association with devotion to the Holy Face of Jesus and for introducing a medal bearing an image from the Shroud of Turin as part of this devotion. She was beatified on Sunday, 30 May 2010 at the Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore in Rome.
